hero.title: Anime nights, socials, and community on campus
hero.subtitle: Step into weekly screenings, trivia battles, cosplay showcases, and themed campus socials built for every kind of anime fan.

clubDescription: AnimeUNSW is a student-run anime society at UNSW where members meet for screenings, games, creative showcases, and community events every term.
eventsOverview: Expect a full seasonal lineup: watch parties, social mixers, tournament-style trivia, cosplay spotlight nights, and opening-song challenges.
sponsorPerksOverview: Members unlock partner perks across manga stores, food spots, and hobby retailers with event-night specials and promo codes.
discordOverview: Discord is our command center for announcements, reminders, signups, and daily anime discussion between on-campus events.
